request.raw_text: Change that vertical slot to cut through complete body to decrease weight

aim.primary_aim: Make the referenced vertical slot extend through the complete body so the final body has reduced weight.

functional_design_intentions.name: Weight reduction
functional_design_intentions.description: Decrease the weight of the body by making the referenced vertical slot pass through its complete thickness.

targets_to_change.action: change slot extent to through the complete body

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: non-targeted body geometry and the vertical slot properties other than its extent through the body
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all geometry and slot properties not required to make the referenced vertical slot pass through the complete body.

geometry.description: The referenced vertical slot passes through the complete body.

functions.name: Weight reduction
functions.description: The through-slot decreases the weight of the body.

behaviors.name: Reduced body mass
behaviors.description: Extending the slot through the complete body removes additional body material, resulting in lower mass than before the change.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that the referenced vertical slot extends through the complete body with no remaining body material closing the slot along its through direction.
Verify that the final body has decreased weight relative to the pre-edit body.
Verify that the through-slot removes additional material and produces lower body mass than the prior slot extent.
Verify that non-targeted body geometry and slot properties unrelated to the through extent remain unchanged.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase "that vertical slot" does not provide an exact feature ID, so the specific slot must be resolved from model context.
candidate_interpretations: The vertical slot selected or otherwise indicated in the engineering context
The only vertical slot present in the model

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not identify the body by an exact ID or define the reference direction used to classify the slot as vertical.
candidate_interpretations: The body containing the referenced slot and the model's established vertical direction
The active or context-selected body and viewing-context vertical direction
